title: Left Atrial Strain-Current Review of Clinical Applications
content: Left atrial strain has gained significant attention in recent years due to its potential to provide valuable insights into the function and mechanics of the left atrium, and more. This review aims to evaluate the current applications of LA strain in clinical practice, particularly in the assessment of various cardiac conditions, including heart failure, atrial fibrillation, valvular heart disease and coronary artery disease. We summarize the latest evidence regarding the role of left arial strain in assessing left atrial remodeling, predicting outcomes, and its potential use as a prognostic tool. Left atrial strain emerges as a promising non-invasive marker for evaluating atrial function and guiding clinical decision-making, but further research is necessary to fully establish its role across diverse patient populations.
